label: FL_B300_CAMPAIGN
o1_transfer_command: import os,sys; ok=all(os.path.isfile(p) for p in ('/outputs/o1_results.tar.gz.sha256','/outputs/O1_RESULT_MANIFEST.json')); print('O1 transferred its own results' if ok else 'O1 result receipt missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 3)
terminate_command: echo 'FL TERMINATE handover: the off-pod driver terminates this pod on the session marker (TERMINATION_LADDER stop 1); watchdog + terminateAfter are armed'
_resolved_note: Resolved 2026-08-22 for the first combined B300/B200 session. O1 gets at most 14,000 s: the local reference-rate probe (o1_b200/reports/LOCAL_REFERENCE_RATE_PROBE.json, 27 s/row on a laptop 5070 Ti) projects ~7,000-9,000 s for 4,608 rows on a B200, and O1's affordability gate needs 1.3x + 1,500 s. FL receives what O1 does not USE (its clock is actual elapsed), with the 3,000 s minimum guaranteed on both profiles (14,000 + 3,000 < 18,250 B300 / 21,200 B200). The supervisor takes min(session_authorized_seconds, O1_SESSION_AUTHORIZED_SECONDS) minus a provisioning allowance. FL results and the durable mirror live under the FL_B300_CAMPAIGN prefix of the existing results repo.
